title: Resolution model of relative etale cohomology and its cone maps
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and $G$ an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with a nonnegative injective resolution $I$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For an etale object $U$, evaluate $I$ at $U$ and extend the section complex by zero in negative degrees. Restriction from the terminal object gives a complex map $r$. Define the relative section complex as $\operatorname{Cone}(r)[-1]$, using the actual cone and shift of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and define $H^q(T,U;G)$ in this model as its homology. For an open $U$ this is the cone of derived global-section restriction of [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. A strictly commuting square between two restriction maps induces the shifted cone map. The shifted first cone projection gives the map forgetting support to absolute sections.
